_about: IBM Technology video manifest for the oodarag YouTube connector.
_why_a_manifest: www.youtube.com is refused at CONNECT from the container this was built
in, so no scraping path reaches it. raw.githubusercontent.com answers for
any public repository and is on the allowlist. Committing the corpus to a
repository therefore makes it reachable by a route that works, instead of
unreachable by one that does not.
or, on a checkout:  ooda index --youtube corpus/ibm-technology/manifest.json
_provenance: Video ids and titles were obtained by web search from this environment.
Captions were NOT fetched: youtube.com is unreachable here and the Data
API refuses caption download to anyone but the video's owner, at any key.
No entry carries a summary or a description written by this session. A
paragraph about a video, stored beside it, reads exactly like a transcript
once it has been chunked, and a citation pointing at it would look
verbatim while being a paraphrase. That is the failure the citation
To add real transcripts: drop `<video_id>.en.vtt` beside this file and
commit it. The connector fetches captions from the manifest's own
directory, local or remote, and the entry becomes `captions`.

_verification.search_confirmed: two or more independent results attribute it to IBM Technology
_verification.search_listed: a search result carried the watch URL and title; the channel attribution comes from the result summary and was not confirmed against the channel, which is unreachable here
